channel.title: Hotel Buffets on YumFam
channel.description: Recent content in Hotel Buffets on YumFam

item.title: Shanghai Chunfeng Campsite — All-You-Can-Eat Outdoor BBQ from ¥39.9 (Kids)
item.description: Chunfeng Campsite's two Shanghai locations (Minhang & Jiading): all-you-can-eat outdoor BBQ with 30+ ingredients, free playground games, plus seasonal perks — stream fish-catching on weekends and a free Straw Culture Festival — from ¥39.9 for kids.

item.title: Xiamen Beihaiwan — 'Crayfish Festival' Buffet, 1 Adult + 1 Kid from ¥118 (+ Free Playground Ticket)
item.description: Beihaiwan Howard Johnson Wanda Plaza Xiamen's 'Crayfish Festival' all-you-can-eat buffet: 10+ crayfish flavors done fresh to order, plus sashimi, grilled stations, sushi bar and dozens of desserts — with a free kids' trampoline park or waterpark ticket thrown in.

item.title: HNA Westin Guangzhou — 'Fish & Crab Feast' Buffet, 2 Adults + 2 Kids from ¥348
item.description: Westin's 'Fish & Crab Feast' all-you-can-eat buffet in Guangzhou: thick-cut salmon, seafood stations, per-seat Buddha-Jumps-Over-the-Wall at weekend lunch and per-seat hairy crab + live band at weekend dinner, with kids' themed activities.
